purpose: Record the October 27-28 institutional payment-rail announcements involving Coinbase, Ripple, RLUSD, Circle, ACI Worldwide and Colombia; distinguish operational availability, pilot/evaluation, roadmap and unknown actual capital.

claims: Coinbase made RLUSD available to supported-region retail and institutional customers through Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and the Coinbase retail app.
At launch, deposits and withdrawals were supported on the XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum.
Customers could convert USD into RLUSD at a 1:1 rate.
Ripple said it would provide liquidity on Base to support RLUSD use on that network.
Coinbase Global Exchange customer availability, including use of RLUSD as collateral, was described as a future phase with no launch date stated.

corroboration.independence_note: Reuters independently reports the announcement but the product terms originate from the same Coinbase/Ripple launch; do not count as a separate executed transaction dataset.

confirmed_edges.relation: retail, exchange and Prime distribution; trade/manage access

limits: Supported-region and product eligibility restrictions apply.
Availability on three networks does not establish equal liquidity, depth, settlement volume or redemption speed on each network.
No chain-specific Coinbase RLUSD balances, net deposits, withdrawals, market-maker inventory or executed settlement volumes were disclosed in the launch announcement.
The future Coinbase Global Exchange collateral phase is not treated as live.
RLUSD transfers on XRPL do not by themselves prove that XRP was used as the bridge asset.
1:1 USD conversion is a product conversion feature; it is not evidence of an independent secondary-market price always remaining exactly one dollar.

claims: Circle and ACI Worldwide announced a collaboration to demonstrate USDC settlement integrated into existing banking and payment infrastructure.
The initiative initially focuses on Colombia and uses ACI Connetic.
The announcement situates the work alongside Bre-B, Colombia's interoperable instant account-to-account payment ecosystem, whose central infrastructure ACI says it built.
The stated purpose is to help financial institutions evaluate USDC settlement within familiar payment operations, treasury processes and governance frameworks.
ACI describes Connetic as supporting traditional payment types, digital assets and card payments through a unified orchestration platform.
limits: This is described as a pilot/initiative to demonstrate and evaluate integration, not proof of production-scale settlement.
No named participating bank, merchant, end customer, transaction count, settlement value, corridor volume or production go-live date is disclosed.
No XRP, XRPL, Ripple or Coinbase role is identified in this pilot announcement.
The platform's ability to support an evolving multi-rail ecosystem is not evidence that any specific non-USDC asset is integrated.

relationship_graph.relation: same ledger, but XRP bridge usage not established by listing
no integration disclosed in the Colombia pilot

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's RLUSD support could expand RLUSD access and liquidity on XRPL.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Coinbase explicitly supports RLUSD deposits and withdrawals on XRPL and makes the token available through retail, Exchange and Prime.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No synchronized Coinbase XRPL RLUSD deposit/withdrawal series, XRPL order-book/AMM depth change, issuer minting attributable to Coinbase or net external settlement volume is disclosed.
measurable_tests: Coinbase-tagged XRPL issuer/holder balances where publicly attributable
RLUSD XRPL mint, redemption and transfer history
XRPL DEX/AMM depth and executed volume
Coinbase RLUSD deposits/withdrawals by network if publicly disclosed

competing_hypotheses.claim: More RLUSD activity on XRPL necessarily increases demand for XRP as a bridge asset.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: XRP is native to XRPL and can serve as a bridge asset in some multi-asset paths.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: RLUSD can transfer directly as a stablecoin; the Coinbase announcement supports RLUSD on XRPL, Base and Ethereum but does not state that XRP is used in transfers or conversion routes.
measurable_tests: Path-level XRPL DEX swaps involving XRP
Executed XRP intermediary volume versus direct RLUSD transfer volume

competing_hypotheses.claim: ACI/Circle's Colombia USDC integration could compete with some cross-border or account-to-account payment use cases where XRP-based liquidity routes might otherwise be considered.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: The pilot is designed to orchestrate USDC settlement alongside existing payment infrastructure and Bre-B.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No XRP route, named bank, production corridor, payment volume, FX spread or cost comparison is disclosed. ACI describes a multi-rail platform and could theoretically support multiple assets.
measurable_tests: USDC settlement value and transaction count
Alternative rail settlement time and liquidity cost
Any explicit ACI support for XRP or Ripple Payments

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase is reducing single-issuer dependence while retaining strong economics from USDC distribution.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Coinbase launched RLUSD across major product surfaces while continuing its USDC commercial relationship and listing other stablecoins.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No issuer-level revenue share, customer migration, stablecoin balance substitution or net distribution economics for RLUSD are disclosed.
measurable_tests: Same-period USDC and RLUSD balances on Coinbase
Coinbase stablecoin revenue/distribution costs by issuer
Prime and Exchange RLUSD trading/deposit/withdrawal activity
USDC-to-RLUSD conversion and net flow data

feature_admission.coinbase_rlusd_network_availability: Categorical product-availability feature, with region/product scope and announcement date.
feature_admission.coinbase_rlusd_collateral: NOT_ADMITTED as live until Coinbase Global Exchange announces and documents the collateral phase.
feature_admission.ripple_base_liquidity_commitment: Announced commitment only; require actual pool/market-maker/chain data before quantifying.
feature_admission.circle_aci_colombia_pilot: Pilot-status event feature only; no production volume or XRP demand inferred.
feature_admission.xrp_bridge_demand: NOT_ADMITTED without path-level executed XRP intermediary swaps.
feature_admission.usdc_competitive_impact: Scenario variable only until actual pilot volumes, cost and route shares are measured.

source_independence.coinbase_and_ripple_launch_releases: Same partner announcement family; two official pages are not two independent executed-volume sources.
source_independence.reuters_coinbase_rlusd_report: Independent journalism about the same announced event, not independent on-chain evidence.
source_independence.circle_and_aci_pilot_releases: Same joint announcement family; two publisher pages do not independently establish live settlement volumes.

forecast.reason: The announcements establish distribution and pilot scope, not synchronized XRP market flows, chain-specific settlement volumes or validated causal effects. No calibrated out-of-sample model evidence supports a directional XRP forecast.

next_actions: Capture Coinbase RLUSD supported-network balances and any publicly attributable XRPL deposits/withdrawals after launch.
Monitor Coinbase Global Exchange collateral documentation and record the date only if the future phase becomes operational.
Track Ripple-provided Base RLUSD liquidity using identified pools, market-maker addresses and synchronized reserves where public data permits.
Track Circle/ACI Colombia pilot go-live, named participants and measured settlement values; do not count the announcement as executed capital.
Compare USDC and RLUSD network-specific supply, depth, redemption and settlement without assuming substitution.
Test whether XRP appears as an actual intermediary asset in executed XRPL swaps rather than inferring bridge use from co-location.
Reconcile these developments with SBI/Startale's exploratory JPYSC-OUSD interoperability; shared Open Standard membership is not a live Coinbase-JPYSC integration.
